name: dev-process
description: Pete's development process, packaged for reuse: spec-driven delivery from idea to shipped tasks, plus the gates and rituals that thirty phases of building taught us to add.

plugins.name: spec-driven-delivery
plugins.description: Idea to shipped software as a sequence of reviewable artifacts: refine the spec, architect it, break it into tasks, then build under a working agreement with real gates. Includes the phase-boundary ritual, the issue-review loop, and a catalogue of the ways a green test suite lies to you.
